blocks.text: 35 questions: five from each of the 7 chapters, in a random order.

Your first answer to each question is the one that counts. 85% or better passes, and passing earns the badge for Counting Things. You can take it as often as you like; the questions are dealt afresh each time.

exercises.prompt: The smell took three days to wear off.
We've survived two wars.
The snow is two metres deep.
The two cities are connected by this highway.
